_readme: Curated overrides for scripts/sync-shop.mjs. Keyed by Shopify product id. Anything not listed here is built straight from Shopify. Shopify tags also work: 'hero-hat' / 'hero-jersey' fill the Hero Lineup, 'cat:hats' etc. force a category, 'sold-out' forces Sold Out, 'hide-web' keeps a product off the site.
